CAP_INT_006: SELECT m.segment, COUNT(r.holding_id) AS record_count FROM investors m LEFT JOIN holdings r ON m.investor_id=r.investor_id GROUP BY m.segment ORDER BY m.segment;

CAP_INT_008: SELECT m.investor_name, r.holding_id, c.security_name, r.status FROM investors m JOIN holdings r ON m.investor_id=r.investor_id JOIN securities c ON r.security_id=c.security_id ORDER BY r.holding_id;
CAP_INT_009: SELECT m.investor_id,m.investor_name,SUM(r.market_value) AS total_amount FROM investors m JOIN holdings r ON m.investor_id=r.investor_id GROUP BY m.investor_id,m.investor_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

CAP_INT_012: SELECT r.holding_id,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Completed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS completed_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Failed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS failed_amount FROM holdings r LEFT JOIN trades e ON r.holding_id=e.holding_id GROUP BY r.holding_id ORDER BY r.holding_id;

CAP_INT_015: SELECT c.security_id,c.security_name FROM securities c LEFT JOIN holdings r ON c.security_id=r.security_id WHERE r.holding_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.security_id;
CAP_INT_016: SELECT m.investor_id,m.investor_name,MIN(r.acquired_date) AS first_date FROM investors m JOIN holdings r ON m.investor_id=r.investor_id GROUP BY m.investor_id,m.investor_name ORDER BY m.investor_id;

CAP_INT_019: SELECT c.category,AVG(e.amount) AS average_event_amount FROM securities c JOIN holdings r ON c.security_id=r.security_id JOIN trades e ON r.holding_id=e.holding_id GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY c.category;
CAP_INT_020: SELECT m.segment,r.status,COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM investors m JOIN holdings r ON m.investor_id=r.investor_id GROUP BY m.segment,r.status ORDER BY m.segment,r.status;
CAP_EXP_001: WITH totals AS (SELECT m.investor_id,m.investor_name,SUM(e.amount) total_amount FROM investors m JOIN holdings r ON m.investor_id=r.investor_id JOIN trades e ON r.holding_id=e.holding_id GROUP BY m.investor_id,m.investor_name) SELECT investor_id,investor_name,total_amount,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS amount_rank FROM totals ORDER BY amount_rank,investor_id;
CAP_EXP_002: SELECT r.holding_id,MAX(e.trade_date) AS latest_event_date FROM holdings r LEFT JOIN trades e ON r.holding_id=e.holding_id GROUP BY r.holding_id HAVING MAX(e.trade_date)<DATE '2026-01-01' OR MAX(e.trade_date) IS NULL ORDER BY r.holding_id;
CAP_EXP_003: WITH totals AS (SELECT investor_id,SUM(market_value) total_amount FROM holdings GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT investor_id,total_amount FROM totals WHERE total_amount>(SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM totals) ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
CAP_EXP_004: SELECT holding_id,market_value,CASE WHEN market_value>=100000 THEN 'High' WHEN market_value>=50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END amount_band FROM holdings ORDER BY holding_id;
CAP_EXP_005: WITH monthly AS (SELECT holding_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',trade_date)::date event_month,SUM(amount) monthly_amount FROM trades GROUP BY holding_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',trade_date)) SELECT holding_id,event_month,monthly_amount,LAG(monthly_amount) OVER(PARTITION BY holding_id ORDER BY event_month) previous_month_amount FROM monthly ORDER BY holding_id,event_month;
CAP_EXP_006: SELECT holding_id,trade_id,trade_date,amount,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY holding_id ORDER BY trade_date,trade_id) running_amount FROM trades ORDER BY holding_id,trade_date,trade_id;
CAP_EXP_007: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY holding_id ORDER BY amount DESC,trade_id) rn FROM trades e) SELECT trade_id,holding_id,amount FROM ranked WHERE rn<=2 ORDER BY holding_id,rn;
CAP_EXP_008: WITH totals AS (SELECT r.holding_id,COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) total_amount FROM holdings r LEFT JOIN trades e ON r.holding_id=e.holding_id GROUP BY r.holding_id) SELECT holding_id,total_amount,ROUND(100.0*total_amount/NULLIF(SUM(total_amount) OVER(),0),2) percent_of_total FROM totals ORDER BY holding_id;
CAP_EXP_009: SELECT investor_id,holding_id,market_value,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY investor_id ORDER BY market_value DESC) amount_rank FROM holdings ORDER BY investor_id,amount_rank,holding_id;
CAP_EXP_010: SELECT holding_id,trade_id,trade_date,amount,LAG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY holding_id ORDER BY trade_date,trade_id) previous_amount FROM trades ORDER BY holding_id,trade_date,trade_id;
CAP_EXP_011: SELECT holding_id,trade_id,trade_date,amount,AVG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY holding_id ORDER BY trade_date,trade_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) moving_average FROM trades ORDER BY holding_id,trade_date,trade_id;
CAP_EXP_012: SELECT m.investor_id,m.investor_name FROM investors m WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holdings r WHERE r.investor_id=m.investor_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holdings r WHERE r.investor_id=m.investor_id AND r.status<>'Active') ORDER BY m.investor_id;
CAP_EXP_013: SELECT holding_id,status,market_value FROM holdings r WHERE market_value>(SELECT AVG(x.market_value) FROM holdings x WHERE x.status=r.status) ORDER BY status,market_value DESC;
CAP_EXP_014: SELECT r.holding_id,MIN(e.trade_date) first_event,MAX(e.trade_date) last_event,MAX(e.trade_date)-MIN(e.trade_date) active_days FROM holdings r JOIN trades e ON r.holding_id=e.holding_id GROUP BY r.holding_id ORDER BY r.holding_id;
CAP_EXP_015: SELECT trade_id,holding_id,amount,ROUND(100.0*amount/NULLIF(SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY holding_id),0),2) record_percent FROM trades ORDER BY holding_id,trade_id;
CAP_EXP_016: WITH totals AS (SELECT m.investor_id,m.investor_name,m.segment,SUM(r.market_value) total_amount FROM investors m JOIN holdings r ON m.investor_id=r.investor_id GROUP BY m.investor_id,m.investor_name,m.segment), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_amount DESC,investor_id) rn FROM totals) SELECT investor_id,investor_name,segment,total_amount FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY segment;
CAP_EXP_017: SELECT trade_id,holding_id,amount FROM trades e WHERE amount>(SELECT AVG(x.amount) FROM trades x WHERE x.holding_id=e.holding_id) ORDER BY holding_id,amount DESC;
CAP_EXP_018: WITH counts AS (SELECT m.investor_id,m.investor_name,COUNT(r.holding_id) record_count FROM investors m LEFT JOIN holdings r ON m.investor_id=r.investor_id GROUP BY m.investor_id,m.investor_name) SELECT investor_id,investor_name,record_count FROM counts WHERE record_count>(SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM counts) ORDER BY record_count DESC,investor_id;
CAP_EXP_019: SELECT r.holding_id,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Completed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) completed_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Pending' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) pending_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Failed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) failed_amount FROM holdings r LEFT JOIN trades e ON r.holding_id=e.holding_id GROUP BY r.holding_id ORDER BY r.holding_id;
CAP_EXP_020: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY holding_id ORDER BY trade_date DESC,trade_id DESC) rn FROM trades e) SELECT trade_id,holding_id,trade_date,trade_type,amount,status FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY holding_id;
